# Debug commands

> **One-shot limitation**: debug session state (observe baselines, experiment undo stacks, active recordings) lives in process memory and does NOT survive across CLI invocations — the first `brp debug observe` always diffs against an empty baseline. For session work use `bevy_copilot mcp`, whose state lives for the server's lifetime; journals it stops are saved to `<state dir>/journal.jsonl`, which `brp debug replay` reads back.

## brp debug observe

Query components for all entities and diff against the previous snapshot

```text
Query components for all entities and diff against the previous snapshot

Usage: bevy_copilot brp debug observe [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --components <COMPONENTS>  Component type paths to query and diff
      --host <HOST>              Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --port <PORT>              Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>        Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

## brp debug nl-query

Run a natural-language query as a BRP world.query with post-filtering

```text
Run a natural-language query as a BRP world.query with post-filtering

Usage: bevy_copilot brp debug nl-query [OPTIONS] --query <QUERY>

Options:
      --host <HOST>        Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --query <QUERY>      Natural-language query, e.g. `entities with my_game::Health where my_game::Health.value < 50`
      --port <PORT>        Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>  Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help               Print help
```

## brp debug experiment

Drive the undo/redo experiment session

```text
Drive the undo/redo experiment session

Usage: bevy_copilot brp debug experiment [OPTIONS] --action <ACTION>

Options:
      --action <ACTION>
          Session action; reset discards local history after inspecting an uncertain write

          Possible values:
          - mutate
          - insert
          - remove
          - spawn
          - undo
          - redo
          - reset:  Discard local history after inspecting an uncertain remote outcome

      --host <HOST>
          Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)

      --entity <ENTITY>
          Target entity ID (mutate, insert, remove)

      --port <PORT>
          Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)

      --compact <COMPACT>
          Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false
          
          [possible values: true, false]

      --component <COMPONENT>
          Component type path (mutate)

      --path <PATH>
          Bevy reflection path (mutate): fields, tuple indices, [array indices], or empty root

      --value <VALUE>
          New field value (mutate; any JSON)

      --components <COMPONENTS>
          Components payload: a type-path→value map for insert/spawn, an array of component type paths for remove

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

MCP peer: `brp_debug_experiment`

## brp debug hypothesis

Rerun setup ops + an assertion and report pass-rate statistics

```text
Rerun setup ops + an assertion and report pass-rate statistics

Usage: bevy_copilot brp debug hypothesis [OPTIONS] --assertion <ASSERTION> --runs <RUNS> --target <TARGET>

Options:
      --host <HOST>            Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --setup <SETUP>          Calls to replay before each run: an array of `{"method", "params"}` objects
      --assertion <ASSERTION>  Assertion object `{"method", "params", "pointer", "op", "expected"}`: call `method` with `params` (default null), extract `pointer` (a dot path into the result; empty = whole result), compare with `op` (one of `<, <=, >, >=, ==, !=`) against `expected`
      --port <PORT>            Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>      Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
      --runs <RUNS>            Number of runs to perform (maximum: 10000)
      --target <TARGET>        Target pass-rate threshold (0.0..1.0)
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_debug_hypothesis`

## brp debug checkpoint
